name: Deep Streams Zen Institute
reason: Not a practice centre we can list cleanly: it has no hall of its own since moving from San Francisco to Studio City, offers Zoom sittings and individual instruction with Joseph Bobrow Roshi, and much of its programme and talks are framed around psychotherapy, PTSD and war-trauma healing and social activism (health and political rules). Site largely unchanged since 2020; contact is a personal gmail address.
